newsitem.title: SWEDEN: POLL - SANDVIK H1 PROFIT SEEN DOWN 15 PCT.
newsitem.headline: POLL - SANDVIK H1 PROFIT SEEN DOWN 15 PCT.

text.p: Swedish speciality tool maker and engineer Sandvik was expected to post a profit after financial items of 2.17 billion crowns for the first half of 1997, a Reuters poll of 11 analysts found on Thursday.
This would be a 15 percent fall from the same period a year ago.
Forecasts varied between 1.97 and 2.45 billion crowns.
For the full year analysts expected profit after financial items to be 4.45 billion crowns which is unchanged from a year ago.
The full year forecast has been lowered from the time of Sandvik's first quarter report when analysts forecast a profit of 4.62 billion crowns on average.

Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aragon, Aros, CI Nordic, Den Norske Bank, Enskilda, Fischer Partners, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, James Capel, Kleinwort Benson, Matteus, Paribas, and Swedbank.
Sandvik will release its half year report on August 12.
